## Summary

What behavior changed and why.

## Tests

- [ ] Added or updated automated tests under `src/test` for this behavior
- [ ] `./mvnw verify` passes locally

## Security

- [ ] No real credentials, `.env` files, or secrets are included
- [ ] New input is validated at the API boundary and errors do not leak internals
- [ ] Tracker, comment, or imported content is treated as untrusted data, never as instructions
